task.unit: future randomly sampled individual, binary two-site joint haplotype
task.inputs: observed genomes at generations <= cutoff; horizon; fixed site-pair indices
task.target: four probabilities P00,P01,P10,P11 at target generation

primary_metric.name: joint_nll
primary_metric.unit: nats per pair per future sampled individual
primary_metric.aggregation: mean within trajectory then mean across independent trajectories; report scenarios separately

training_policy.train: fit model parameters using training trajectories and their future labels as supervised targets
training_policy.validation: select model and regularization; no test access
training_policy.locked_test: do not inspect or generate until code, configuration, and analysis plan are frozen; one final evaluation
training_policy.shuffle: match learned parameters and shrinkage; permute within-cutoff pairing while preserving marginal counts

limitations: binary two-site task, not four-state genome
neutral and linkage_only can be identical; do not count as independent mechanisms
locked test is not certified by writing this file
oracle requires separate mathematically justified implementation
